series.name: Why does your body…
series.format: A body reaction everyone has had (chills, yawns, hiccups). Hook on the moment, x-ray cutaway of the one mechanism, a surprising twist, kind loop back. 30-40 s.
series.example: Why does your favorite song give you goosebumps?

series.name: Feelings explained
series.format: One feeling (nerves, crying, being left out), shown as what the brain and body actually do, ending on a kind reframe that makes the viewer feel normal. 30-40 s.
series.hookFormula: That ___ feeling when ___? Here's what's really happening.
series.example: That shaky feeling before a test? Your body thinks it's helping.

series.name: Your crush's brain
series.format: Crush-level, innocent romance science: what happens in your brain when you like someone. Sakumai gets flustered, then explains. 30-40 s.
series.hookFormula: When you like someone, your brain secretly ___.
series.example: When you like someone, your brain treats them like a reward.

series.name: Night mode
series.format: Sleep, dreams and the night-time body, in pajamas under a night sky or in her bedroom. Calm pace, one cosy twist. 30-40 s.
series.example: While you dream, your body switches your muscles off.
